result.notes: Vercel REST API is documented at vercel.com/docs/rest-api with 400+ endpoints across dozens of resource groups (projects, deployments, domains, dns, env vars, edge-config, webhooks, teams, etc). Auth is via personal Bearer access tokens created in Account Settings (free on the Hobby plan) or OAuth2 tokens issued to Marketplace/native integrations (response schema shows token type \"oauth2-token\" with origin e.g. \"github\"). No app review needed to create a personal token and call the API; building a distributable OAuth integration for the Marketplace goes through Vercel's integration developer flow but isn't required for basic API/agent use. Vercel publishes vercel/mcp-handler, an official SDK/framework for building MCP servers on Vercel (used by the community mcp-vercel server too), though it is a framework rather than a single hosted MCP endpoint.
result.one_liner: Vercel is a cloud platform for deploying and hosting frontend/web applications, with a REST API to manage projects, deployments, domains, and team resources.
